facts.text: Serve the drinks when Chon and Roy hit the saloon in Carson City.
facts.why: The saloon brawl where Chon and Roy meet is in a town that is not Carson City, the barman says so. Carson City is where the bordello hideout is.
facts.fix: Serve the drinks when Chon and Roy brawl in the saloon on the way to Carson City.

facts.text: I came to rescue a princess, Roy. Now pass the noodles before you eat them all.
facts.why: Not a Chon line, and the card prints it in quote marks. The Wikiquote page has nothing like it. It reads fine as a note in his voice.
facts.fix: Roy, I came here to rescue a princess. Pass the noodles before you eat them all.

fix_note.text: Roy, I came here to rescue a princess. Pass the noodles before you eat them all.

facts.text: Roy's drinking game, bathtub not included.
facts.why: Roy is the one who says it would be fun to play a drinking game with Chon at the hideout. The bathtub part is a plain joke that claims nothing.

vibe.verdict: A good Carson City saloon with the train ticket and noodles note, but chipichawa, the chopsticks and Roy buried in the sand don't print.
